Two corn pieces sit on a square plate that is roughly 26 cm across. In the image the plate spans about 420 px, so 1 cm is about 16 px.

The round-cut piece is about 95 px across, or roughly 5.5 cm, and about 2.5 cm thick. That gives a volume of about 60 cm³, and with the cob included it weighs roughly 50 g.

The other piece is about 115 px long (about 7 cm) and 90 px wide (about 5.5 cm). Its volume is about 130 cm³ if I treat it as a cylinder, but I'll estimate about 65 g because it is a partial cut. Together the two pieces come to about 115 g.

There is also one loose kernel, which I'll count at about 0.5 g and leave out as negligible.

The pieces are probably cob segments, so I'll count the cob in the weight. Corn on the cob has about 96 kcal per 100 g.
